title: Geolocation
description: Origin and destination geohashes — where an order originates and terminates. Composed for ANY modality: a physical shipment route, a service jurisdiction, or geofenced digital delivery. Carries no physical-shipment assumption; mass and volume live in the elective figaro-cargo clause.

fields.name: originGeohash
fields.description: Origin geohash (base32). 1–12 characters; longer = higher precision. Default "0" is the minimal valid placeholder (whole-region cell) pending a real value at commit time.

fields.name: destinationGeohash
fields.description: Destination geohash (base32). 1–12 characters; longer = higher precision. Default "0" is the minimal valid placeholder (whole-region cell) pending a real value at commit time.
